body.statement:
Conditional on the effective-compatible-density theorem and \(\text{ass:local-tangent-fiber-neighborhood}\), assume \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), \(c_n\to0\), and the compact-uniform local expansion.  Then on every rational compact polytope \(C\), \(\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) and \([B'\operatorname{diag}\{p_n(0)\}^{-1}B]^{-1}\to\Sigma_0\).  Every finite atomic dual certificate for \(\mathfrak G_0\) is contained in a compact local-direction set admitting an eventually lawful multinomial realization, and transfer of that fixed certificate yields \(\liminf_{n\to\infty}M_n\geq M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0)\).  Moreover, the required reverse inequality is the existence of one sequence \((K_n)\) with \(K_n\in\mathcal C_{n,\eta_0}\) globally on \(D_{n,v}\), obtained from certified zero-offset Gaussian rules by an expanding-domain transfer and exact repair, such that
\[
 \limsup_{n\to\infty}\sup_{u\in H_{n,r_0}}
 E_{p_n(u)}[\ell_0\{K_n(N_n)\}]
 \leq M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0).
\]
Consequently \(M_n\to M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0)\).  The compact certificate is chosen before the compact set is exhausted; no bounded-support condition is imposed on least-favorable Gaussian dual mass.
body.justification: The corrected theorem preserves the full two-sided minimax-convergence target and makes every zero-offset limit premise and the required single global primal construction explicit.
body.gap: Finite atomic duality supports the certificate-first \(\liminf\) route, but compact comparison does not control escaping separated means or deliver the globally honest primal needed for \(\limsup\le M_{\mathfrak G_0,\eta_0}(r_0)\).
body.consumer: Only after both inequalities are proved may the Job Corps archive interpret the Gaussian certificate as the local multinomial minimax benchmark for the identical assertion list.

obligation.what_is_open: Prove both the certificate-first lower transfer and the reverse inequality by constructing one globally honest transferred primal on the expanding lawful multinomial domain.
obligation.obstruction: The added zero-offset, compact-remainder, and covariance conditions identify \(\mathfrak G_0\) on every fixed compact. They do not control the experiment or rule on points of \(H_{n,r_0}\) escaping every compact, so reporting the full label set outside a core can raise maximal diameter risk to one.
obligation.attempted: Finite dual supports were localized first, and the drift counterexample was removed by \(c_n\to0\). For the upper bound, compact diagonalization and full-set repair were examined, but neither preserves the Gaussian minimax risk on escaping separated means.
obligation.partial_result: Under \(c_n\to0\), the compact-uniform expansion, and base convergence, every fixed finite Gaussian dual support has eventually matching zero-offset signs away from a boundary band, and the efficient covariance converges to \(\Sigma_0\).  Thus the certificate-first lower-transfer route is reduced to the missing quantitative experiment comparison.  The reverse inequality remains more demanding: compact-local convergence alone does not control the rule, labels, or experiment comparison on \(H_{n,r_0}\) outside every fixed compact, so no single globally honest expanding-domain primal has yet been constructed.
